title: Cairn Community Connector
description: One connectors/<id>/connector.json — an installable MCP server, HTTP service, slash command, or AI provider preset. manifest.json (MCP + services + commands) and providers.json (AI providers) are COMPILED from these by scripts/build-manifest.mjs; never hand-edit the compiled manifests.

version.description: SemVer of THIS entry; bump to push an update to installed users.

category.description: The single category chip this connector groups under in Browse Community.

tags.description: Freeform keywords for search only (not shown as chips).

blurb.description: One-line description for the browse card.

icon.description: Connector logo. Use exactly ONE of: slug (a simpleicons.org slug — fetched + sanitized by CI), svg (inline SVG string), or file (a .svg next to connector.json). Omit for the app's generic fallback.

ProviderDefinition.description: An AI provider preset — a one-click OpenAI-compatible endpoint installed into Cairn's shared saved-providers list. Compiled into providers.json (a SEPARATE manifest from manifest.json). The user supplies their own API key at install; it is stored in the OS keychain, never here.

name.description: Display name seeded into the saved provider (e.g. "OpenAI", "OpenRouter").

defaultModel.description: Optional model id to seed the provider with; omit to let the user pick from the live /models list after install.

needsApiKey.description: Whether this endpoint requires an API key. false = keyless / local endpoint.

apiKeyUrl.description: Where the user can obtain a key — rendered as a "Get a key" link in the install prompt.

models.description: Optional curated model ids offered by the picker before a live /models fetch succeeds.

credits.description: Optional credit/balance lookup. When present, Cairn queries this endpoint (instead of the default {base}/v1/key probe) to show remaining credits, and parses the response per `shape`.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint returning the provider's credit/balance info (some providers expose it off the chat base, e.g. DeepSeek at the host root).

shape.description: Response-shape parser: "openrouter" = { data: { limit, limit_remaining, usage, is_free_tier } }; "deepseek" = { is_available, balance_infos: [{ currency, total_balance, ... }] }; "openai-grants" = { total_granted, total_used, total_available }; "neuralwatt" = { balance: { credits_remaining_usd, total_credits_usd, credits_used_usd } }.

CommandDefinition.description: A slash command — a reusable prompt/text snippet surfaced in Cairn's chat and/or coding-agent input palettes. Installed workspace-globally with source:"community". Commands never execute code; they only insert `insertText` into the input for the user to send.

name.description: The command trigger, invoked as /name. Lowercase, digits and hyphens only.

description.description: Shown beside the command in the palette and Browse Community.

insertText.description: The text inserted into the input when the command is chosen. Typically a prompt template; may contain [placeholder] hints for the user to fill in.

scope.description: Which input pane(s) the command appears in: the AI chat panel, the coding-agent input, or both.

ServiceDefinition.description: An HTTP service. Either a legacy single-op (apiUrl + method + toolDefinition) OR a multi-op service (baseUrl + operations[]). Multi-op is preferred: one connector can expose several tools that share a base URL + headers/auth.

apiUrl.description: Legacy single-op endpoint. Use baseUrl + operations for multi-op.

headers.description: Shared across all operations. Use <API_KEY> as a placeholder to inject the stored key.

toolDefinition.description: Legacy single-op stringified OpenAI tool JSON.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for multi-op services; each operation's path is appended.

operations.description: Multi-op definition. Each operation becomes its own namespaced tool (svc__<id>__<opName>).

name.description: Un-namespaced tool name, unique within the service.

path.description: Appended to baseUrl. {placeholder} segments are filled from arguments, e.g. /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}.

toolDefinition.description: Stringified OpenAI tool JSON for this operation.

paramLocations.description: Where each argument goes. Args named by a {placeholder} in path are auto 'path'. Unlisted args default to query (GET/DELETE) or body (POST/PUT).

query.description: Static query params ALWAYS sent for this operation (e.g. units, format, or a fixed field list). Supplied by the connector so results don't depend on the model passing an optional arg. A model arg of the same name overrides.

responseKeys.description: Default response key allow-list (an operation may override it).

authMode.description: 'none' (default) = static/keychain header secrets. 'oauth' = OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in; Cairn auto-refreshes tokens and injects Authorization: Bearer per request.

oauth.description: OAuth parameters for authMode:'oauth'. Omit serverUrl to run discovery + dynamic client registration against the apiUrl/baseUrl origin (works for any modern DCR-capable authorization server).

serverUrl.description: Authorization-server discovery base (defaults to the apiUrl/baseUrl origin).

clientId.description: Preregistered client id for vendors without DCR (Phase C).

automationDefinition.description: Automation recipe: instructions + schedule the agent runs on. Installed by pre-filling the New Automation form (user can tweak schedule/approval before saving).

name.description: Display name prefilled into the automation.

instructions.description: Prompt replayed on every run — only data tools (notes/tasks/tags/boards), no shell.

approvalMode.description: auto = writes run freely; ask = park writes behind the approval inbox.
